label: Bible Study
prompt: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to _____;
verse: A time to weep, and a time to laugh; a time to mourn, and a time to dance;
note: From the 'season' poem the Byrds turned into the 1965 hit 'Turn! Turn! Turn!'

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Thou in thy _____ hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
verse: Thou in thy mercy hast led forth the people which thou hast redeemed: thou hast guided them in thy strength unto thy holy habitation.
note: From the Song of the Sea: God's mercy leads and His strength guides — all the way to His holy habitation.

label: Sunday School
prompt: But Jehoiada the priest took a _____, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
verse: But Jehoiada the priest took a chest, and bored a hole in the lid of it, and set it beside the altar, on the right side as one cometh into the house of the LORD: and the priests that kept the door put therein all the money that was brought into the house of the LORD.
note: Jehoiada bored a hole in a chest's lid for temple repair money — a priestly offering box.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Thou art _____, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
verse: Thou art worthy, O Lord, to receive glory and honour and power: for thou hast created all things, and for thy pleasure they are and were created.
note: The elders cast their crowns before the throne and sing — worthy, because he created all things.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her _____ is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
verse: He was oppressed, and he was afflicted, yet he opened not his mouth: he is brought as a lamb to the slaughter, and as a sheep before her shearers is dumb, so he openeth not his mouth.
note: Silent as a sheep before her 'shearers' — the Ethiopian eunuch was reading this very passage when Philip arrived (Acts 8:32).
